description: Mirror of the stream-0 half of the ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM rule, from the CLIENT's perspective: the server sends a stream-0 DATA frame whose payload exceeds the 16 KiB control-channel limit. OVERVIEW.md section 2.4 limits table: 'Stream-0 payload <= 16 KiB' -> conn ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM; section 2.7 envelope table restates it. Caught at frame-decode time (js/src/frame.ts), before the JSON is ever parsed.
